qualificationBasis.decision: The maintainer confirmed that the current DeepSeek Harness qualification matrix was completed without blocking issues on macOS x64 and explicitly approved release on all four shipped platform keys.
qualificationBasis.rawEvidencePolicy: Credentials, prompts, machine paths, Native Session identifiers, Run identifiers and raw target-host logs remain private and are intentionally excluded from the repository.

runtimeEvidence.mcpStrategy: native stdio and HTTP MCP with whole-definition Rovai precedence
runtimeEvidence.permissionStrategy: native DSH sandbox and approval authority

acceptance.checklist: The maintainer confirmed completion of the current 14-axis Runtime integration matrix and required Golden Flows without a blocking issue.
acceptance.machineAndExecutionBoundary: Installation, authentication, model availability, Session health and dispatch readiness remain independent fail-closed checks on each machine.

limitations: This artifact records the maintainer's completed target-host acceptance and release decision; this promotion commit does not claim to rerun the private macOS x64 model sessions or possess their raw logs.
The exact host OS build and executable fingerprint were not supplied to this promotion commit and are not inferred from macOS arm64, Linux x64 or Windows x64 evidence.
ACP still lacks session/load, additionalDirectories, a manual compact command, compaction lifecycle, MCP SSE/resources/prompts and client filesystem/terminal bridges.
Platform qualification does not bypass ordinary machine installation, authentication, model, version, Probe or Ready checks.
